parsed.post: Latest run (0.842003) is a new best despite the shard-10 leakage. The downward trend from LR 0.06 -> 0.05 -> 0.04 seems very consistent. For the final round, I will push the limit and test MATRIX_LR=0.03 to see if even more conservative steps improve convergence within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate further to 0.03 to test if even more conservative optimizer steps improve convergence within the fixed 5-minute training budget.
